technical_and_design_decisions: Integrate the reactor-based gpfdist module directly into the core spring-xd repository, updating build definitions and dependency configurations.
Implement a Git-backed Module Registry implementation using JGit to allow centralized module synchronization across cluster nodes via GitHub.
Enhance the Mail source module schema and spring configuration to accept custom javaMailProperties bean definitions for IMAPS and SSL/TLS support.
Refactor custom module persistence logic to default to HDFS storage and update YARN build specifications to exclude custom-modules.zip.
Add a startup hook in spring-xd-shell to locate and auto-execute default init scripts (e.g., /etc/springxd/conf/xd-shell.init).
Design a graceful shutdown mechanism for streams in Spring XD container lifecycle management, ensuring message channels drain before undeployment completes.
assumptions: Development work is performed by a single developer proficient in Java, Spring Framework, Spring XD, Spring Integration, and Hadoop ecosystem tools.
Access to Rackspace test infrastructure and RabbitMQ deployment scripts is available for benchmarking.
The target Spring XD environment supports HDFS and Git-based authentication standard protocols.
Effort includes unit testing, integration testing, documentation, and feature verification.

activities.activity_name: Migrate gpfdist sink module to spring-xd core (U1)
activities.activity_description: Move the reactor-based gpfdist code from spring-xd-modules repository into spring-xd core repo, update Gradle build scripts, dependency management, and implement GPDB/HAWQ sink integration tests.
Implement Git repository provider for the Module Registry in Spring XD, allowing admins and container nodes to fetch and push modules to a centralized GitHub repository.

Set up test environment on Rackspace infrastructure, create benchmarking workloads for RabbitMQ bus scalability across multiple xd-container nodes, collect performance metrics, and summarize findings.

activities.activity_name: Improve Flo parser endpoint error reporting (U4)
activities.activity_description: Enhance Flo DSL parser REST endpoints to capture detailed syntax and semantic error information, returning structured error payloads for better UI diagnosis.

activities.activity_name: Support SSL/TLS and JavaMail properties in Mail source (U5)
activities.activity_description: Update Mail source module definition XML/configuration to support referencing a javaMailProperties bean for secure IMAP/SMTP server connection settings.

activities.activity_name: Set HDFS as default remote location for custom modules & YARN build cleanup (U6)
activities.activity_description: Update REST API and shell upload logic to default custom module registry to HDFS, and update YARN packaging to remove custom-modules.zip artifact.

activities.activity_name: Implement XD Shell auto-configuration init script (U7)
activities.activity_description: Update XD Shell initialization logic to check for default init script files upon startup and auto-execute contained commands.

activities.activity_name: Implement graceful stream undeployment and shutdown (U8)
activities.activity_description: Implement stream draining and graceful unbinding mechanisms in the container so active tasks finish processing to the sink prior to stream shutdown.

activities.activity_name: Integration testing, cross-cutting verification, and documentation
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end testing across all user stories, verify build artifacts, update documentation, and ensure regression testing passes.
